author: blu
body: 3D particle rendering. Takes a ParticleSystem and renders each particle as a camera-facing billboard (two triangles). Particles are sorted back-to-front for correct alpha blending. Size scales with distance. Color fades with remaining lifetime.

author: reek
body: A Particle holds integer world coordinates and Mat4 is Real, so the position crosses into clip space and the billboard crosses back. At v4w = 1.0 the w is a true homogeneous coordinate, where the old fixed-point code carried thousandths -- which is also why the screen size divides by w directly now rather than scaling by a thousand first.
